model: AUDEMARS PIGUET Royal Oak Double Balance Wheel Openworked 41 15407ST (41 mm steel, skeleton dial, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). Follows the ROYAL OAK 41 TEMPLATE (spec, step pipeline/steps/watch_audemars_royaloak41.py used read-only, kit lighting): case slab from the alpha silhouette sloping into the bracelet, octagon bezel ring sampled by rays with a thin chamfer, eight screw heads (rose gold in the photo, projected), flat dial plate with the 2x photo map, hands from profile lists, hexagonal crown from the trace, INTEGRATED steel bracelet from the measured seams and two continuous pin-link bars. OPENWORKED dial: the skeleton movement (barrel, gear train, double balance wheel, bridges, rubies), the rose-gold flange ring with the minute track and the baton indices, the AUDEMARS PIGUET print and the see-through cut-outs (composited on white) are photo texture only on the flat dial plate; no openwork cut-out geometry (out of scope). The 3D parts are the hands, hub, bezel, screws, crown, case and bracelet.

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tops (tip_top / tip_bottom = the first seam of the bracelet, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the crown rows replaced by a straight line, top and bottom sloping toward the bracelet; bezel = octagon ring (min of the octagon and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the opening at chamfer_z

dial.note: flat plate out to opening.dial_flat_mm, rim to the opening (ring_z = z); one lathe with the 2x photo map (skeleton movement and rose-gold flange ring as photographed, cut-outs composited on white)

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; measured on the photo (hour full width 7.6 px, minute about 9 px incl. its dark facet, seconds needle 0.6 px half width). Plain polished steel hands, no luminous inlay objects. Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: the crown comes from trace.crowns: hexagonal steel cap (flat face toward the viewer) from the base point along the axis angle (3 o'clock, no guards, no ring)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

bracelet.note: links and bars from trace.bracelet (seams, bars), their outer edges follow the silhouette; heights relative before the depth scale: pieces z 3.55 (the case tip is 3.4), the pin-link bars +bar_lift; a dark backing under all of it shows in the seams. gap = x gap between the columns (negative = overlap, no hairlines); seam_shrink = mm the link pieces reach into each seam
